plan_review.notes: Adversarial review rejected the initial sidecar-heavy single-system plan. Alt A explicit floor-scoped ECS markers plus split pre/post authority was adopted. Alt B reuse generic combatant AI mode was partially rejected because generic Enemy tagging would cause AI/drop leakage, but existing path/passability and applyDamage are still reused. Alt C authored lane waypoints was adopted as the movement model. Resolutions: add SiegeMinion/SiegeStructure markers; split siegeMinionSystem pre-step from floor5ObjectiveTick post-damage captures/audits/terminal; add Floor 5 progress telemetry; use stable manifest slot ids with transient EIDs; make command post entity health authoritative; audit combat events/health deltas independently; pin ScenarioDefinition ordering; keep generic combat/pathfinding changes minimal.
